documents.text: The hurdle model is a two-stage model: a binary classifier predicting P(demand > 0) and conditional quantile regressors for quantity given demand > 0.
The binary classifier uses P90 forecast as demand probability signal. Higher P90 means higher probability of demand > 0. Returns binary flag: 1 if P90 > threshold else 0. Default threshold is 0.5.

The hurdle model prediction combines binary probability with conditional quantiles: hurdle_10 = demand_binary * quantile_10, hurdle_50 = demand_binary * quantile_50, hurdle_90 = demand_binary * quantile_90. If demand_binary is 0, all hurdle predictions are 0.
